title: Add ELO Rating Category to NBA Feature Engine
source: MDPI 2026 — Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets (doi:10.3390/info17010056)

finding.summary: SHAP analysis across multiple 2025-2026 NBA prediction papers consistently identifies team_elo, elo_5y (5-year rolling ELO), and home_next (next game is home) as the top-3 most influential features — more predictive than any other single feature category.
finding.best_model: Logistic Regression with ELO + rolling averages (tabular baseline)
finding.note: Our current LR in CPU_MODEL_TYPES can achieve this IF ELO features are present in the engine. Currently verifying.

current_state.elo_present: UNKNOWN — need to grep features/engine.py for 'elo'

proposed_change.what: Add Cat44 ELO_RATINGS category to features/engine.py
proposed_change.implementation_note: Add to build_features() return dict. ELO can be computed from existing game results in the DB — no external API needed.

expected_impact.mechanism: ELO captures long-term team quality and momentum in a single number. Provides signal that rolling form averages miss (team quality vs. schedule difficulty).

related_finding.title: LR baseline already deployed — good
related_finding.detail: NBA CPU_MODEL_TYPES already includes logistic_regression. Islands can discover the LR + ELO combination that achieves 0.199 Brier. This proposal enables that discovery.

secondary_finding.title: LightGBM DART already deployed — confirmed good
secondary_finding.detail: NBA hf-space/app.py model builder uses boosting_type='dart'. This aligns with 2025 literature recommendations for better-calibrated gradient boosting.

implementation_status: PROPOSED — Kaggle Karpathy loop is best venue to test this (GPU, can iterate quickly). If Brier improves, port to features/engine.py and sync to all 6 HF spaces.
